title: Copy-site instruction
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$, a copy site $k$, and a Boolean value $b$, define an instruction that increments the destination register of $k$ and returns to $k$ when $b$ is true. When $b$ is false, it tests whether the destination and source registers of $k$ are equal, continuing to the next site if they are and proceeding to the copy-and-increment site otherwise.
caveat: The formal statement uses register-selection functions for copy sites whose definitions are not included in the supplied context, so the register roles and branch destinations cannot be independently checked.
